Title: Get all products returns the product list
Expected Response: A "products" list where every product has id, name, price, brand, and category. Data matches the website (e.g., Blue Top, Rs. 500, Polo).
Actual Result: As expected. HTTP 200 OK, responseCode 200, 34 products with the same structure. Blue Top: Rs. 500, Polo, matching the website. Response time 1.50 s.
Comments: Content-Type is text/html instead of application/json, see OBS-08.

API Reference: API 2: POST To All Products List
Title: POST to products list is rejected
Expected Response: Message: "This request method is not supported."
Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK. Body: responseCode 405, message "This request method is not supported."
Comments: The body is correct, but the HTTP status is 200, see OBS-09.

Title: Get all brands returns the brand list
Expected Response: A "brands" list where every item has "id" and "brand", with each brand listed once, matching the website's Brands sidebar (8 brands).
Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK, responseCode 200. Response time 1.40 s. The list has 34 items, but only 8 different brands; brands are repeated (e.g., "Polo" appears 6 times). The website shows 8 brands, each once.
Comments: See OBS-10. Content-Type is text/html, see OBS-08.

Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK. Body: responseCode 405, message "This request method is not supported."

Title: POST to search product is accepted
Expected Response: Every returned product contains "top" in its name or category.
Actual Result: HTTP 200 OK, responseCode 200. 14 products returned. All results contain "top" in the name or are in the "Tops" category.
